# Trimble Geospatial Field Configuration

- **Product:** Trimble Geospatial Field Configuration (Geospatial family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** OAuth 2.0 (Trimble Identity, id.trimble.com). Declared security schemes: Trimble Identity.
- **Access:** Customer.
- **To call it you would need:** a Trimble Identity token with the field configuration service scope.
- **Documented servers:** `https://cloud.api.trimble.com/geospatial/fieldconfiguration-service/1.0/`.
- **Definition:** [geospatial/field-configuration-v1](https://cloud.api.trimble.com/geospatial/fieldconfiguration-service/1.0/openapi/OpenApi3_0.yaml) (Field Configuration Service, version 1.0.0). Documentation: https://developer.trimble.com/docs/geospatial/reference/openapi/field-configuration/v1/.
